versions.changelog: 入口与各层节点增加概览级功能说明

- Initial release of "代码引用" (code-yinyong) skill.
- Generates an upstream Java method caller graph, tracing to HTTP endpoints, RPC methods, or other entry points within the current Git repository.
- Limits search scope to the current repo (including monorepo submodules); does not cross service boundaries.
- Supports multiple input formats (class.method, file+method, pasted signatures) and clarifies ambiguous targets.
- Uses GitNexus if available for efficient call tracing, with `rg`-based fallback when needed.
- Outputs summaries, Mermaid call graphs, detailed entry point tables, and key code evidence in Chinese.
